colorSelectionRule: palette-algorithm.v1 selection plus an exact-black-white guard: when chromatic coverage >= 0.25 or best eligible chromatic score share >= 0.20, replace only the non-dominant extreme with the highest-ranked eligible chromatic bin
colorSpaceQuantization: decoder RGBA converted to deterministic RGB channels quantized to 16-channel steps

minimumDistinctness.correction: farthest observed color, then source-luminance neutral pair

neutralPosterBehavior: low-chroma sources remain neutral; no saturated fallback is introduced
samplingResizing: nearest-neighbor center samples on a maximum 64x96 grid
